missing_cuts_and_varieties: No specific cooking times or liquid ratios for whole beef brisket in oven or smoker.
No parameters for beef short ribs (English cut vs flanken cut braising curves).
No guidelines for beef tongue, oxtail, or cheek braises.
missing_methods: No sous-vide precision water bath parameters for ground beef or whole pot roasts.
No pressure cooker / Instant Pot high-pressure timing charts for pot roasts.
missing_parameters: Exact collagen-to-gelatin conversion rates between grass-fed versus grain-fed beef chuck roasts.
Quantitative moisture-loss comparison between 80/20 versus 90/10 ground beef patties.

app_recommendations: Enforce strict 160°F (71.1°C) internal doneness for all ground beef dishes; emphasize in app UI that internal color is not an indicator of doneness.
For braised pot roasts and stews, differentiate from quick-searing steak rules: direct users to cook chuck roast far past 145°F to 195°F–205°F to ensure collagen melts into gelatin.
Instruct users never to press down on hamburger patties with a spatula while searing in skillet.
Provide two-stage browning logic for stews: brown floured beef cubes in uncrowded batches first, then deglaze with broth or wine before simmering.
